notes: The STL holds the device twice (the assembly at x -12..12 mm and a copy further along -x), each as two pieces: the front cap (24 x 48 x 8.4 mm: screen window with its lip, the M5 key as a flexure tongue, the power key's flexure on the left wall) and the back shell (24 x 48 x 10.5 mm: BtnB's flexure on the right wall, the label recess, the header pocket at the top, the stepped bottom with the Grove notch and the screw pockets). Its front faces -Z with +Y up the screen, so the transform turns it 180 degrees about Y and moves the assembly to x 0..24, y 0..48, z -13.5..0, the front at z = 0. There is no display, connector, header, LED, label, insert or screw in it: those are added here from measurements.json, M5Stack's dimension drawing (header pitch, Grove and USB-C on the bottom end, screws 16 mm apart 4.5 mm from the bottom, inserts 9.4 mm) and the vendor photos (label print, screw finish). The window's lip opening is 14.8 x 24.86 mm (x 4.6..19.4, y 19.575..44.435), M5Stack's drawn active rectangle; the screen quad is the datasheet's 14.86 x 24.91 mm on the same center, so the lip covers 0.03 mm of it at each side. The case is 13.5 mm deep, as M5Stack's drawing and published size give it. The model's origin is the center of the 24 x 48 x 13.5 mm body.

volumes.note: fill: the opaque interior every opening shows (the M5 key's slot, the side slots, the keys' slits, the ends); above y 38.55 it stops short of the header pocket, and below y 9.8 short of the stepped bottom (above the screw pockets' floor at z -9.05), the USB-C receptacle and the Grove housing. lcd: the LCD module in the window's pocket, behind the lip.

meshes.name: glass
meshes.note: The visible glass of front.svg (x 4.49..19.51, y 3.455..28.525 down from the top), just behind the window's 14.8 x 24.86 mm inner edge.

meshes.name: usb_c_shell
meshes.note: The USB-C receptacle in the bottom end, towards the front (opening x 7.42..16.58, z -1.08..-4.50).

meshes.name: grove
meshes.note: The HY2.0-4P (Grove) housing in the bottom end, towards the back, its back face flush with the stepped back (notch x 5.92..18.08 to z -9.05, x 6.9..17.1 to z -11.1): front, back, left and right walls around the socket, the socket floor, and the ears that fill the notch beside it (towards the back only behind the screw pockets' walls, y 3.35..6.8).

meshes.name: header
meshes.note: The 1x8 female header (2.54 mm pitch) lying in the pocket at the back of the top end, its contacts facing the end and its back under the label.

meshes.name: header_funnels
meshes.note: Each contact: a funneled 1.5 mm entry around a 0.8 mm dark hole.

meshes.name: led_slots
meshes.note: The two slits in the top end at the joint of the shells (x 4.42..5.78 and 7.50..8.90, z -4.00..-4.96), each closed by a black bed: behind them sit the IR LED and the red LED.

meshes.name: back_label
meshes.note: The label's paper: in the back's 0.2 mm recess (x 1.45..22.55, y 7.4..38.6) 21.0 mm wide, as the vendor's back photo measures it, its bottom edge just clear of the inserts, square below; over the header, up to the top end, 20.76 mm wide and rounded at the top corners. What is printed on it is label_legends.

meshes.name: label_legends
meshes.note: What back.svg prints on the label (its label group): the pin row over the header, the M5STICK CPlus 1.1 title, the colored fields, the FCC, CE, WEEE and Japan radio marks, the serial speeds, the maker's mark, the Grove port and PWR, three position steps out from the label's face (z -13.46).

meshes.name: inserts
meshes.note: Brass inserts in the two holes below the label (16 mm apart, 9.4 mm from the bottom).

meshes.name: screws
meshes.note: The two pan-head screws in the pockets of the stepped bottom (16 mm apart, 4.5 mm from the bottom).
